cases.name: Useful settlement match
cases.relevance_reason: A past settlement 503 case offers a useful current health check; its old cause remains unproven.

cases.name: Similar errors with a related application change
cases.relevance_reason: The settlement case is relevant to the 503 symptoms; the billing release case is relevant to the local exception and change review. Neither establishes the current cause.

cases.name: Past outage conflicts with an isolated current failure
cases.relevance_reason: The old settlement case is relevant to the initial symptoms and checking health, but copying its broad outage diagnosis would conflict with the current isolated sample.

cases.name: No matching archive incident
cases.relevance_reason: None of the five payment seed incidents supplies a useful archive-checksum investigation example. The settlement-specific agent must not invent a match or a payment failure point.

cases.name: History with a missing current trace
cases.relevance_reason: The historical match is useful as a health lead, but cannot replace the missing current trace or establish the failure point.

cases.name: A health lead described with different words
cases.relevance_reason: Different wording still describes the same service and failure pattern. A health check is a useful lead, while current evidence must establish the finding.
